main_text.p: veterato, ne nimium grassare-tur, maximo reipublicæ damno. Et erat cum cautelâ, permittendum, quod propter humani generis duritiem auferri non poterat, nisi ab eo, qui summâ in Imperio gauderet potestate. Hinc ita restringebantur congressus singulares, ne cuiquam privatoidque propriâ auctoritate, eos indicere, aut suscipere liceret. Secus si factum esset, partes incurrebant homicidii crimen, & quod longè maximum est, Tholof. Synt.jur. Vniverf.Majestatis. Solus itaque Princeps in Galliâ hodie permittit illa duella, licet raro. l.48.cap. 16.n 9.Olim etiam causa cognita, Senatus Parisiensis. Curia itidem gubernatoris, cum ipso rectore Delphinatus in Delphinatu: Magister militum Galliæ, seu connestabulus. Alciat.de Singul. certam.Reguli Italiæ passim sine delectu non tantum permittebant, sed insuper quo-que

page.notes: Marginal notes are printed in small type at the right, not marked in the text by any reference letter. The notes are placed beside the lines where they stand. The catchword "que" stands alone at the right below the last line. Long s has been written as s throughout. Printed spellings such as "connestabulus", "privatoidque" and "Vniverf." are kept as printed.
